import sqlite3

def search_accounts(user_input: str):
    conn = sqlite3.connect('app.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    query = "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE name = ?"
    cursor.execute(query, (user_input,))
    return cursor.fetchall()
